text: Dune is a masterpiece of science fiction cinema. The world-building is incredible and the cinematography is absolutely stunning.
Timothée Chalamet delivers an outstanding performance as Paul Atreides. The story is complex but engaging.
The visual effects are mind-blowing! Denis Villeneuve has created something truly special here.
I was completely immersed in the world of Arrakis. The soundtrack by Hans Zimmer is phenomenal.
The movie is too slow and confusing. I couldn't follow the plot and fell asleep halfway through.
Overhyped and boring. The characters are flat and the dialogue is pretentious.
Beautiful visuals but the story drags. Not worth the 2.5 hour runtime.
The movie is okay, nothing groundbreaking. Some good moments but overall average.
Mixed feelings about this one. Great production value but the pacing is off.
Rebecca Ferguson is brilliant as Lady Jessica. The political intrigue is fascinating.
The sandworms look amazing! This is how you adapt a complex novel to film.
Too much exposition and not enough action. The book is much better.
The cinematography is breathtaking. Every frame could be a painting.
Disappointing adaptation. They changed too much from the source material.
The movie captures the epic scale of Herbert's universe perfectly.
Zendaya's role is too small but she makes the most of her screen time.
The desert scenes are incredible. You can almost feel the heat and sand.
Too confusing for casual viewers. This is definitely not for everyone.
The spice must flow! This movie does justice to the Dune universe.
Mediocre sci-fi that tries too hard to be profound. Falls flat.
